arrival_analysis.timestamp_boundary: Four ranks on one node; host range entry spread is not exact collective launch spread. GPU scope clipping uses timestamps, not launch ancestry.
arrival_analysis.interpretation: Rank0 waits for others to reach metrics; its 3.089s kernel is not the time to move 72 bytes. Nonroot batch broadcast includes rank0 queue/collation/readiness wait. Other mid-step broadcasts can expose rank imbalance; truncated payload samples cannot locate all occurrences.

batch_dispatch.basis: Collator dtypes plus first sampled Long payload; matches measured whole-batch H2D aggregate within small metadata bytes.
batch_dispatch.correction: Previous comm_audit 44 bytes/token was arithmetic error; four int64 plus two FP32 = 40. DP6 window minimum is 2.6933316 GB (40*67,333,290).
batch_dispatch.transport: Installed Accelerate data_loader.py:894-896 broadcasts full batch before slicing. Nonroot initialize_tensors then send_to_device also copies full-batch allocation before broadcast. Rank-local representation reduces logical payload fourfold; speedup requires timing separately from readiness waiting.
batch_dispatch.sampling_limit: Only first three payload records per kernel name retained. Exact total batch NCCL bytes and all GPU bucket payloads unavailable. CPU c10d lacks dtype/count; parser omits Byte derived bytes.

gradient_communication.extra_gpu_allreduces: Two barrier kernels with sampled Byte0 payload, not two full gradient synchronizations.
gradient_communication.timing_boundary: Final DDP backward host 1.053-1.097s includes compute. NCCL-without-nonNCCL 0.050-0.360s versus reducer event spans 0.618-0.678s are different quantities; neither is pure wire time.
gradient_communication.bucket_view_candidate: gradient_as_bucket_view=False and ~1GB final bucket tunable; evidence supports a small follow-up, not ~13.4s/update savings.

fp8_sparse_probe.scope: Single H200 FP8 2:4 kernel feasibility, not whole RL or training-quality evidence
fp8_sparse_probe.scale_contract: Same rowwise quantized W and X; compare full search configuration, result layouts and vector alpha

limitations: Production throughput remains 151401.486 token/s; 100x v1 and compute MFU20 not achieved.
Four-rank profiled step and profiler stop excluded from throughput; GPU temporal busy is not SM occupancy/MFU or removable production gap.
Native sparse changed tensorwise quantization diagnostic and pruned-weight outputs do not establish dense quality equivalence.
Fixed G32 model probe uses real tokens/weights and synthetic advantages/old-logprob offsets, Adam lr=0; no production inactive mask recorded.
Head graph v3 measures fresh tensor copies, output clones and private graph pool; no runtime integration.
